findings.description: Removing `__reduce_ex__` breaks pickle round-trips for both sentinels. Retain name-based serialization because their `object()` values cannot be reconstructed by value.
findings.rationale: When `Sentinel.UNSET` or `Sentinel.FLAG_NEEDS_VALUE` is pickled, Enum's default reduction serializes its value. Unpickling creates a different object that matches neither enum member, raising ValueError; serialized objects containing either sentinel therefore fail to load.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'python -c $'"'import enum,pickle,copy\\nclass Sentinel(enum.Enum):\\n UNSET=object()\\n FLAG_NEEDS_VALUE=object()\\ns=Sentinel.UNSET\\nfor name,fn in [(\"copy\",copy.copy),(\"deepcopy\",copy.deepcopy),(\"pickle\",lambda x:pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(x)))]:\\n try: print(name,fn(s) is s)\\n except Exception as e: print(name,type(e).__name__,str(e))'"

/bin/zsh -lc 'python -c $'"'import enum,pickle,copy\\nclass Sentinel(enum.Enum):\\n UNSET=object()\\n FLAG_NEEDS_VALUE=object()\\ns=Sentinel.UNSET\\nfor name,fn in [(\"copy\",copy.copy),(\"deepcopy\",copy.deepcopy),(\"pickle\",lambda x:pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(x)))]:\\n try: print(name,fn(s) is s)\\n except Exception as e: print(name,type(e).__name__,str(e))'"
